record.issue_text: Server schema does not enforce guest email uniqueness; duplicate emails pass validation and createMany inserts duplicate attendee rows (addGuests.schema.ts:5)

adjudication.rationale: The server-side ZAddGuestsInputSchema in addGuests.schema.ts only validates that each entry is an email (z.array(z.string().email())) and does not enforce uniqueness. In addGuests.handler.ts, `uniqueGuests` is computed by filtering out emails already in `booking.attendees` and blacklisted emails, but it does not deduplicate duplicates within the incoming `guests` array itself. As a result, an input like `["a@example.com", "a@example.com"]` will pass schema validation and both entries will remain in `uniqueGuests`, leading `createMany` to attempt inserting duplicate attendee rows.
